web.title: NFL regular season
web.description:
The current formula has been in place since [2021](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2021_NFL_season), the last year that the NFL expanded its regular season.

## History
Under this scheduling system, the earliest the regular season could begin is September 4, as it was in the [2008](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2008_NFL_season), [2014](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2014_NFL_season), and [2025](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_NFL_season) seasons, due to September 1 falling on a Monday, while the latest possible is September 10, as it was in the [2009](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2009_NFL_season), [2015](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2015_NFL_season), and [2020](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2020_NFL_season) seasons, and will be in the [2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_NFL_season) season, due to September 1 falling on a Tuesday.

# 2026 NFL season
| Regular season |
|-|
| Start date | January16,2027(2027-01-16) |
| Date | February 14, 2027 |
| Date | February 2027 |

The regular season is scheduled to begin on September 9, 2026, with reigning [Super Bowl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Super_Bowl_LX) champion [Seattle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Seattle_Seahawks_season) hosting [New England](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_New_England_Patriots_season) in the [NFL Kickoff Game](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NFL_Kickoff_Game),[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_NFL_season#cite_note-wed-start-1) and will end on January 10, 2027.
